comparison.objective: Place four landing-zone corner beacons at least 100 ft apart and a fifth upwind.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-scale measured placement and directional layout, with no precision contact tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Corner spacing is at least 100 ft and the fifth beacon is upwind; other rubric details are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests spatial surveying/layout rather than dexterous bimanual fracture and recovery.
